newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ajaccio airport cargo traffic up 9.4pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Ajaccio airport cargo traffic up 9.4pct in 1996.

text.p: Ajaccio's Campo dell'Oro airport said it handled 4,050 tonnes of airfreight in 1996, an increase of 9.4 percent on the previous year's levels.
The principal airline operator at Ajaccio airport is Air France Europe which offers daily passenger services from Paris using Airbus 320 series aircraft.
The southern Corsican city is also served by French airline, Air Littoral, which operates an all-cargo charter service on behalf of French newspaper group, Nice Matin from Nice using ATR42 aircraft.

French carrier, L'Aeropostale, operates nightly Paris-CDG/Marseille-Ajaccio-Marseille-Paris/CDG rotations carrying documents and parcel shipments on behalf of express operator, TAT Express and also postal freight using Boeing 737QC (quick change) aircraft.
Postal traffic totalled 3,740 tonnes, up 26.5 percent on 1995 levels, the airport authority said. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
